description: Create a Klaviyo email CAMPAIGN DRAFT: templateId (create_klaviyo_template), subject, previewText, the audience as listIds and/or segmentIds (excludeIds leaves people out), optional name, fromEmail / fromLabel (default: the account's default sender) and replyTo. It is created as a DRAFT and NOTHING IS SENT; the answer is Klaviyo's own row read back. To send or schedule it use send_klaviyo_campaign, which shows the recipient count first. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: create_klaviyo_campaign
title: Create a Klaviyo campaign draft
